_comment: Unified investment universe. Single source of truth for ticker tracking. Tier per ticker determines daily-routine attention level.
purpose: Wide-net universe of tickers organized by thematic sub-theme. Each entry carries a tier (core_watchlist, scout_active, scout_monitor, hype_speculation, scout_archive, pre_ipo_watch) that determines how Worker B attends to it during daily runs.

tier_definitions.core_watchlist: Daily Worker B full scan. Names with active catalyst monitoring, broader liquidity, generally graduated from scout via signal threshold or strategic importance.
tier_definitions.scout_active: 3 or more of 5 signals on scorecard. Daily lightweight check (scout-flag layer in Worker B). Size 2 to 3 percent of book per name if entered.
tier_definitions.scout_monitor: 1 to 2 of 5 signals. Weekly check. Size 1 to 2 percent if entered.
tier_definitions.hype_speculation: Momentum or narrative play, fewer fundamental signals. Size 0.5 to 1 percent per name. Hard 30 percent drawdown stop. 90-day time-box review.
tier_definitions.scout_archive: Graduated to core_watchlist or thesis broke or post-discovery beyond entry window. Reference only.
tier_definitions.pre_ipo_watch: Private companies on near-term IPO track. Evaluate at S-1 filing.

five_signal_scorecard.1_ma_capability_tuck: Thematic-direction acquisitions that expand addressable use case. 8-K + PRs.
five_signal_scorecard.2_first_named_dod_or_hyperscaler_contrac: Specific customer + specific dollars. SAM.gov / USAspending / 8-K.
five_signal_scorecard.4_revenue_or_backlog_inflection: Sequential acceleration; backlog more than 50 percent QoQ leads revenue 3 to 12 months. Quarterly earnings.
five_signal_scorecard.5_international_or_second_customer_valid: Foreign government, second OEM, second hyperscaler.
five_signal_scorecard.scoring: 3+ signals = scout_active; 4 to 5 signals = candidate for auto-promotion to core_watchlist; less than 3 = scout_monitor or hype_speculation.

auto_promotion_rules.scout_active_to_core_watchlist: Trigger: scorecard reaches 4 or 5 of 5 AND a recent named catalyst exists. PM proposes promotion in next daily run; user confirms.
auto_promotion_rules.core_watchlist_to_scout_monitor: Trigger: no catalyst movement in 90 days AND no thesis-confirming news. PM flags for demotion review.
auto_promotion_rules.scout_archive_trigger: Thesis-break confirmed OR position exited and stopped tracking OR catalyst passed without entry.

sizing_rules.core_watchlist_per_name_max_pct: Per thematic_core target weight in tranches.json (typically 5 to 12 percent).

exclusions: Hard exclusions live in user-specific memory or local config, not in this universe file.

integration_points.invest_daily_worker_b_scout_layer: Worker B's news/movers scan includes scout_active tier — flag any >5% move or named catalyst with one-line note. Lightweight, doesn't drive action.
integration_points.invest_weekly_scout_sweep: Weekly run: full scout sweep — re-screen scout_monitor for catalyst materialization, surface fresh entrants via web search (NVentures portfolio updates, defense-tech filings, AI-pivot announcements, IPO filings). Update tier classifications.

integration_points.quarterly_13f_cross_reference: Post-13F drop: cross-reference SA-LP and other tracked-fund 13Fs against scout_active for confirmation signals.
integration_points.pre_ipo_watch_protocol: When a watched private company files S-1 → spawn immediate evaluation as a potential scout_active entry post-IPO; assess via mini-dossier

review_cadence: core_watchlist: daily Worker B full scan. scout_active: daily lightweight check. scout_monitor: weekly. hype_speculation: weekly with hard 90-day time-box. scout_archive: monthly cleanup review. pre_ipo_watch: continuous + immediate on S-1 filings.
